title: Plucked the slender catgut thong
html_source:
the harp has a long history from ancient Egypt to Greece to the Bible as both a musical instrument and a symbol of Ireland
http://gnosticwarrior.com/harp.html
the harp would become one of the main symbols for these people who we know of by the names of the Cretans, Phoenicians, Ionians, Minoans, Arcadians, Atlanteans, Persians, Greek Hellenes, Hebrews, Scythians, Saxons, Angles, Irish, Picts, and Celts.

Catgut is a type of cord that is prepared from the natural fibre found in the walls of animal intestines. Catgut makers usually use sheep or goat intestines, but occasionally use the intestines of cattle, hogs, horses, mules, or donkeys (not cats).

Also associated with Ireland.
